name: AI Engine
description: The engine of the AI functions that run on this computer: speech recognition, reading aloud and changing the speed of speech. It is installed from the settings page of a function that needs it (Read Aloud, Speech Transcription) and loaded only while such a function is used. It holds no models: they are downloaded on those pages. Nothing is sent anywhere.
author: Quillbinder
whatsNew: The first version: one engine for Read Aloud and Speech Transcription
details: ggml with its compute modules for every processor generation and, where the package has it, Vulkan for NVIDIA, AMD and Intel graphics cards; the processor is the fallback.
whisper.cpp (speech recognition), llama.cpp with libmtmd (Pocket TTS), qwentts.cpp (Qwen3-TTS) and Sonic (the speed of speech, the pitch kept).
Quillbinder reaches it through its small wrapper libqbai (interface version 1); the program itself links none of these libraries.
